summary: Iteration 7 — Third-party live-preview verification requested by user (‘snapshots don't match preview’). Loaded https://premium-apollo.preview.emergentagent.com with cache-buster in a fresh Playwright browser session at desktop/tablet/mobile. Backend pytest 5/5 pass. Frontend header renders EXACTLY as documented (solid navy rgb(10,15,26), sticky top:0, z-index 50, height 101px desktop / 87px mobile, persists across /, /about, /services, /contact). Hero image + logo both load with correct naturalWidth (1013 / 873). No console errors, no page errors, no failed module chunks. document.readyState = complete. ONE real bug found: on mobile 390px viewport the nav-cta (ENQUIRE button) is VISIBLE when it should be hidden — this contradicts the spec and is likely what the user is seeing.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile (390px) the ENQUIRE button has className='btn-gold hidden md:inline-flex' but computed display is 'flex' (not 'none'). Root cause: .btn-gold in /app/frontend/src/index.css line 130 sets `display: inline-flex;` with the SAME specificity as Tailwind's `.hidden` (both are single-class 0,1,0). Since index.css is imported AFTER Tailwind utilities in the cascade, .btn-gold wins and the button stays visible on mobile. The mobile screenshot clearly shows ENQUIRE next to the hamburger, taking up ~40% of the mobile header width. This is a very likely candidate for the user's ‘doesn't match’ complaint.

issues: 4 unique service tiles are rendered TWICE in the DOM (data-testids: service-tile-new-home-builds, -home-renovations, -bathroom-renovations, -kitchen-renovations each appear 2x → 8 total). If this is intentional (marquee/infinite scroll duplication) it's fine, but data-testids should be unique per element for reliable testing — consider suffixing duplicates with -clone.

action_items: FIX MOBILE NAV-CTA: In /app/frontend/src/index.css .btn-gold, either (a) remove `display: inline-flex` and let Tailwind's `inline-flex` utility set it on md+ only, or (b) add `.btn-gold.hidden { display: none; }` override, or (c) bump the specificity of the Tailwind hidden class via `!important` on the JSX (`hidden md:inline-flex` → replace `hidden` with `!hidden md:!inline-flex` in Nav.jsx nav-cta). Option (a) is cleanest since every consumer already uses Tailwind display utilities alongside .btn-gold.
OPTIONAL: If services-tiles duplication is a marquee/infinite-loop, add unique testids to the cloned set (e.g. suffix -b) or wrap clones with aria-hidden='true' data-clone attribute.
critical_code_review_comments: .btn-gold and .btn-navy in index.css both set `display: inline-flex` at 0,1,0 specificity — this fights every Tailwind display utility (hidden, flex, block, grid) applied on the same element. Move display out of the button class OR scope it via :where(.btn-gold):not(.hidden) to keep utility overrides winning.
Home page uses calc(100svh - 100px) but header is 87px on mobile — same finding as iteration 6, still not addressed. Cosmetic 13px gap on <768px devices.
trust-band does not have per-item data-testid (only container has data-testid=trust-band). Consider adding trust-item-* testids for future regression tests.
